subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should owner/human handoff be added first as an opt-in WhatsApp plugin feature, or designed as a shared channel contract across WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord?
rationale: The missing behavior is real in current source, but the fix adds user-facing config, per-conversation pause state, and resume semantics that need a maintainer-owned product boundary before automation should implement it.

options.title: Opt-in WhatsApp handoff first
options.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp-owned owner handoff config and per-DM pause/resume behavior with no default behavior change and live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Design shared channel contract
options.body: Create a common channel-level human takeover API before implementation so WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord share semantics at the cost of a larger surface.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep relying on manual controls and instruction-level workarounds if maintainers do not want another auto-reply policy surface right now.

recommendation.title: Opt-in WhatsApp handoff first
recommendation.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp-owned owner handoff config and per-DM pause/resume behavior with no default behavior change and live WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current evidence points to recent WhatsApp inbound policy and access-control ownership, and that is the narrowest plausible first implementation boundary.
